question: What is the main goal of teaching pregnant mothers about good nutrition during antenatal care?

options.A: To help the mother lose weight during the first trimester
options.B: To guarantee a completely painless labor and delivery
options.C: To eliminate the need for routine blood pressure checks
options.D: To prevent low birth weight and support fetal development

explanation: You've got this! Proper nutrition is key to helping the baby grow strong and healthy while keeping the mother in great shape throughout her pregnancy. [learn more](GNS227_U7_T011#GNS227_U7_T011_h1)

question: Why is it so important for a nurse to check a pregnant patient's diet early on?

options.A: It determines the exact date of conception
options.B: It replaces the need for standard laboratory blood tests
options.C: It allows for the early identification and correction of nutrient deficits
options.D: It stops gestational diabetes from ever developing

explanation: Spotting nutritional gaps early helps you stop issues like tiredness or baby growth delays before they become serious. Great nursing insight! [learn more](GNS227_U7_T011#GNS227_U7_T011_h1)

question: About how much does a normal pregnant woman's total blood volume increase?
explanation: Amazing right? The body ramps up blood volume by about half to care for both the mother and the growing baby. That's why iron and fluids are so crucial! [learn more](GNS227_U7_T011#GNS227_U7_T011_h2)

question: During which part of pregnancy do a mother's daily food energy (calorie) needs go up the most?
explanation: As the baby gets bigger towards the end of pregnancy, calorie needs peak—demanding extra energy to cross the finish line! [learn more](GNS227_U7_T011#GNS227_U7_T011_h2)

question: What is the main reason we give folic acid supplements in early pregnancy?

options.D: To increase daily breast milk production

explanation: Folic acid is a tiny pill with a huge job! It protects the baby's developing brain and spine right from the very start. [learn more](GNS227_U7_T011#GNS227_U7_T011_h3)

question: A patient asks why she needs extra iron when her test shows mild anemia. What is your best reply?

options.A: Your blood volume increases greatly, and iron helps build the extra hemoglobin needed.
options.B: Iron tablets replace the calories you lose from not eating enough protein.
options.C: Iron prevents the baby from developing weak bones and teeth.
options.D: Extra iron is only given to stop morning sickness in the first trimester.

explanation: Because her blood volume stretches so much, the blood gets diluted. Extra iron helps her body build all those extra red blood cells she needs! [learn more](GNS227_U7_T011#GNS227_U7_T011_h3)

question: What is a great food tip for a mum dealing with early morning sickness?

options.A: Consuming a large, high-fat breakfast immediately upon waking
options.B: Drinking two large glasses of citrus juice on an empty stomach
options.C: Eating small, dry carbohydrate snacks like crackers before getting out of bed
options.D: Restricting all fluid intake throughout the entire day

explanation: Dry snacks help settle a restless morning tummy and gently boost blood sugar without triggering nausea. [learn more](GNS227_U7_T011#GNS227_U7_T011_h4)

question: A patient with gestational diabetes asks what diet changes to make. What should you suggest?

options.A: Focus on complex carbohydrates, increase fiber, and eat evenly spaced meals
options.B: Avoid all proteins and eat only sugary fruits for energy
options.C: Eliminate all forms of food and rely only on protein shakes
options.D: Eat large meals twice a day to reduce insulin spikes

explanation: Keeping blood sugar stable is all about steady, fiber-rich meals that digest slowly rather than spiking glucose all at once. [learn more](GNS227_U7_T011#GNS227_U7_T011_h4)

question: Which fish should pregnant women avoid because of the risk of harming the baby's nervous system?

options.A: Low-fat white fish like tilapia and cod
options.B: Canned tuna in small weekly portions
options.C: Freshwater fish caught in local rivers
options.D: High-mercury fish like swordfish and shark

explanation: Fish like swordfish and shark carry higher mercury levels which can cross the placenta, so it's safest for mums to steer clear! [learn more](GNS227_U7_T011#GNS227_U7_T011_h5)

question: Why are pregnant women more easily infected by bugs like listeriosis from unpasteurized foods?

options.A: Their high blood volume washes bacteria directly into the placenta
options.B: They produce more stomach acid which attracts bacteria
options.C: Their cell-mediated immune system is naturally suppressed during pregnancy
options.D: Their liver function slows down and cannot filter toxins

explanation: Nature gently lowers the immune response so the body accepts the baby, but it also means food safety is extra important during pregnancy. [learn more](GNS227_U7_T011#GNS227_U7_T011_h5)

question: Roughly how many extra daily calories does a breastfeeding mother need?
explanation: Making breast milk takes a lot of body power! Mums actually need even more extra energy daily while breastfeeding than they did while pregnant. [learn more](GNS227_U7_T011#GNS227_U7_T011_h6)

question: Why should you advise a new mother NOT to start a crash weight-loss diet right after delivery while breastfeeding?

options.A: It can decrease milk volume and deplete her own nutrient stores
options.B: It will cause the baby to develop an allergy to breast milk
options.C: It stops the uterus from shrinking back to normal size

explanation: Her body needs good nourishment to recover from childbirth and keep up a healthy milk supply for her baby. [learn more](GNS227_U7_T011#GNS227_U7_T011_h6)

question: What is the best approach when advising a pregnant mum on a tight budget about her diet?

options.A: Insisting that she must purchase organic foods to have a healthy baby
options.B: Suggesting affordable, locally available food alternatives that meet her nutritional needs
options.C: Skipping dietary counseling because poverty makes nutrition impossible to change
options.D: Telling her to buy expensive imported supplements from specialized pharmacies

explanation: Great nursing care is practical and real! Always guide patients toward nourishing, budget-friendly local foods they can actually access. [learn more](GNS227_U7_T011#GNS227_U7_T011_h7)

question: Which communication trick helps a nurse truly understand what a patient normally eats?

options.A: Assuming all patients eat the same traditional hospital diet
options.B: Handing out a pamphlet and asking if they can read
options.C: Reading a strict list of forbidden foods and waiting for agreement
options.D: Asking open-ended questions about what foods the patient eats at home

explanation: Open-ended questions like 'Tell me what you usually eat in a day' invite honest chats and help you give advice that fits their real life. [learn more](GNS227_U7_T011#GNS227_U7_T011_h7)
